test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 03 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the correct idiom to substitute the underlined word segment in the following sentence.**

She trusted her husband but he __stabbed her in the neck__ when he usurped her inheritance.
solution:
The correct answer is **'stabbed her in the back'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct idiom to substitute** "stabbed her in the neck" **in the given sentence is: **stabbed her in the back.**
 
• This idiom means** to betray someone's trust or confidence.**
 
• In the context of the sentence, it implies that **the husband betrayed his wife's trust and acted against her,** similar to how one would betray someone by stabbing them in the back.
